title: Practice 7: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The cat is playing with a mouse.
exercises.why: **играть → играет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You must leave the diagnosis to your doctor.
exercises.why: **следовать → следует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Milk is made into butter.
exercises.why: **перерабатываться → перерабатывается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том каждое утро ___ (выпивать) стакан воды натощак.
exercises.prompt: Tom drinks a glass of water on an empty stomach every morning.
exercises.why: **выпивать → выпивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You deserve congratulations.
exercises.why: **заслуживать → заслуживаешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Танец ___ (представлять) собой совокупность движений, которые выполняются в ритме музыки.
exercises.prompt: Dance is a set of movements that are performed following the rhythm of the music.
exercises.why: **представлять → представляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Technology is always improving.
exercises.why: **совершенствоваться → совершенствуется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom always makes me laugh.
exercises.why: **смешить → смешит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They falsify the numbers.
exercises.why: **подделывать → подделывают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We hope Tom hasn't been seriously hurt.
exercises.why: **надеяться → надеемся** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том ___ (добавлять) в воду химикалии, делающие из лягушек геев.
exercises.prompt: Tom is putting chemicals in the water that turn the frogs gay.
exercises.why: **добавлять → добавляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Father Tom is praying in the old chapel.
exercises.why: **молиться → молится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Бесчеловечность бога к человеку ___ (заставлять) бесчисленные множества роптать.
exercises.prompt: God's inhumanity to man makes countless thousands mourn.
exercises.why: **заставлять → заставляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom makes TikTok videos.
exercises.why: **снимать → снимает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Структуры в языке C ___ (позволять) группировать скалярные переменные, такие как координаты точки.
exercises.prompt: C structures allow the grouping of scalar variables, such as the coordinates of a point.
exercises.why: **позволять → позволяют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I hear a magpie cawing.
exercises.why: **слышать → слышу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Are you coming to Rio for the Olympics?
exercises.why: **ехать → едешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She's a tarot reader.
exercises.why: **гадать → гадает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom often drinks cognac.
exercises.why: **пить → пьёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This is the pipeline which supplies the town with gas.
exercises.why: **снабжать → снабжает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
